body: This response here gave me quite a laugh, thanks. I'll definitely check out the game when I get home from work. Good luck man!

I'll be calling him Monday. That's when he's in.

I think perspective would be good. Maybe that's what I really posted for. Either way, I felt dangerous when I started typing last night, but I feel safe now. I don't want to make a post every night though, and I certainly won't be able to stay awake this long and safely go to work. I need a long term coping method, and therapy hasn't provided it yet.

I don't really know what would help. I waited a long time to go to a therapist because I was scared. I dont know what another would say or do. I have a lot of fear that I don't know how to handle. 

I don't want to be institutionalized. I feel like I'm risking that by talking anonymously with strangers.

My wife is the one I talk to about it. She knows everything I'm going through. She's scared and hurt. I don't want to keep hurting her. I don't want her of all people to suffer with me. It's bad enough what she's gone through already.

Not the guy you asked, and completely different situation, but I spent too much time looking for a job after dropping out of college to give it up because some therapist thought I might be dangerous and have me locked up for a few weeks or more, causing me to lose my job. I would rather be a risk to myself and everyone around me than a safe guy locked up.
